text_block_list.name: Watching Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: A-Amazing! Inari-senpai's running like she's tearing the dirt to shreds...!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Phew, got myself a bit dirty.
Well, I guess you could call it a badge of hard work.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I had confidence in my strength even before coming to the academy. Lately, though, it's gotten even sharper.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it's a big stage, after all.
To put on a truly spectacular run,
having too much power is hardly a bad thing, right?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, had another great run today.
Guess it's about time to wrap things up—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um, Inari-senpai! If it's all right,
would you care to do a tandem gallop with us?!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I want to study the way you run, Inari-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
W-What's the big idea?!
Barging in here with a whole crowd?!
choice_data_list: I get why you'd want to barge right in.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Geez, you talk like it's none of your business. But well, being this popular really is a blessing, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks to a certain someone who takes care of me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Alrighty then!
Time to give it one more push!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, put some spirit into it!
You won't even warm up like that!
And so, Inari One powerfully coached her juniors.
